title: Address Check
summary: Checks a shipping address for a missing house number, a postcode that doesn't fit the country or city, and PO boxes, so parcels aren't returned.
description: Catches a missing flat or house number, a postcode that doesn't fit the country (or fits another one), a city the postcode lookup places elsewhere and PO boxes couriers can't reach, with one-tap fixes and a live readback of the printed label.
catches: No flat or house number in the street line
Postcodes in the wrong shape for the country, or that fit another country
A city that differs from where your postcode lookup places it
PO boxes that couriers can't deliver to
Postcode formatting fixed to the canonical shape (e.g. SW1A 1AA)
limits: Postcode formats are built in per country; it doesn't confirm the address exists
The city check needs a lookupPostcode function from you
a11y: Each field has a hint in an aria-live="polite" region
Fixes and dismissals are buttons with visible text
